conventions.spinor: chi+(n) = (cos(theta/2), exp(i phi) sin(theta/2)), chi-(n) = chi+(-n); complex numbers are [re, im]
conventions.su2: U(n, t) = cos(t/2) - i sin(t/2) n.sigma; U (v.sigma) U^+ = (R v).sigma
conventions.hop: amplitude of the hop from port p of the first carrier to port q of the second: keep = <chi+_q| U |chi+_p>, flip = <chi-_q| U |chi+_p>; the reverse hop has the complex conjugate keep amplitude (U replaced by U^-1)
conventions.z: z_keep = keep / |keep| is the recharting phase for the covariant agreement pump and for section bands of helicity 1/2; intra-carrier seams use z_ab = phase of <chi_b|chi_a> with the template axes (chart) or the ambient axes (ambient)
conventions.flux_unit: 2 pi / 20; a carrier face oriented outward has flux -1 unit in this spinor convention (helicity +1/2)

cells: cell indices and vertex order of s0_lib.build_mesh(level) = pinned builder order
glue_port_of_cell_edge: W[c][k] is the port of carrier c glued across the mesh edge opposite the k-th vertex of cell c
